Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
Added "Find apartment" to the Ward Info panel on the ward select menu. It visits every apartment building in that district (wards 1 to 30, main and subdivision) and stops at the first one with free rooms, showing how many are free and the first room number. Press Continue to keep searching and collect more, or OK to stop. Requires Lifestream for travel.
Added an optional sound that plays when an apartment is found (off by default), under the Ward Info settings.
